name: onetouchswitch
description: Static-only UK broadband comparison for onetouchswitch.com: runs entirely on GitHub Pages (or any static host) with client-side JS. OS Code-Point Open postcodes as static chunks, manual address, reviewed versioned offer catalogue, deterministic dinero.js engine in the browser, guides + search, saved comparisons in localStorage, in-browser PDF bill reading, offline service worker. No server, database, queue or third-party API at runtime.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.engine.config.mjs && node scripts/build-static.mjs
